answer: Each identity registers one reef sample, locks a 70-credit bond, and files a signed record in the reef log and a copy in the oasis mirror archive. An auditor cross-checks filings: serial and hash must match; a missing mirror copy, reused serial, or one sample under two keys burns the bond. The first fee is 40, the kth pays 40+6(k-1), so the 1000th pays 6034 and 1000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-sample ring fails because the sample is already filed under the seller key, so its mirror copy mismatches. An honest identity pays 40 once and recovers the bond.
